Thanks, Liam. I found your account and looked through your orders. Here's where things stand.

**1. Luggage set and skateboard (order #W3295833).** This order hasn't shipped yet. Its status is "pending", not "delivered", so I can't process a return or exchange on it. I can change the items in the order before it ships, which gets you the same result. One rule applies here. I can only change items on an order once, so we need to settle the luggage set and the skateboard together.
- **Luggage set.** You have the 2-piece, black, softshell set at $452.28. The same set in red (2-piece, softshell) is in stock at $499.29, which is $47.01 more.
- **Skateboard.** You have the bamboo, 31-inch, graphic design board at $195.15. Which board would you like instead? For example, there's bamboo 31-inch in a custom design ($193.97) or a plain design ($200.80). Bamboo graphic also comes in 28-inch ($180.10) and 34-inch ($193.79). Other materials are available too.

You'll also need a payment method for the price difference. That can be your PayPal (paypal_3650980) or your Visa ending in 3194.

**2. Hiking boots (order #W8488728).** This order has been delivered, so I can return the boots (size 11, leather, not waterproof, $245.99). The refund can go back to the PayPal account you paid with.

Let me know which skateboard you want and how you'd like to pay the difference. Also tell me if there's anything else in order #W3295833 you want to change. I'll list all the details for your confirmation before I make any changes.

Okay, thanks, though I doubt it'll go smoothly. I'd like the skateboard in 34 inch with a custom design, if that even exists. For the price difference I'll use my credit card, the Visa. And yes, please go ahead with returning the hiking boots too.

Good news, it does exist. Since your current board is bamboo, I've gone with the bamboo 34-inch custom design at $217.06. There's also a plastic 34-inch custom board at $184.13 if you'd rather have that one. Here's everything for you to confirm.

**Action 1. Change the items in pending order #W3295833:**
- Luggage set. The 2-piece black softshell set ($452.28) becomes the 2-piece red softshell set ($499.29).
- Skateboard. The bamboo 31-inch graphic board ($195.15) becomes the bamboo 34-inch custom board ($217.06).
- Your Visa ending in 3194 will be charged the $68.92 difference.
- The portable charger stays as it is.
- Please note that items on this order can only be changed once. After this, I can't change or cancel the order again. Is there anything else in this order you want to change?

**Action 2. Return the hiking boots from delivered order #W8488728:**
- Hiking boots (size 11, leather, not waterproof), $245.99.
- Your refund of $245.99 goes back to the original payment method, PayPal (paypal_3650980).
- The order status will change to "return requested", and you'll get an email explaining how to send the boots back.

Do you want me to go ahead with both actions? Please reply "yes" to confirm. You can also tell me what to change, for example if you'd prefer the plastic board.
Okay, yes, go ahead with both. Nothing else in that order needs changing. I just hope nothing goes wrong with it.

**Luggage set and skateboard (order #W3295833).** Both items have been changed. The order status is now "pending (item modified)".
- The skateboard line shows the bamboo 34-inch custom board at $217.06, which is right.
- The luggage set line has the correct item ID (7160999700). When I look that item up on its own, it shows the 2-piece red softshell set at $499.29, which is what you asked for.
- Your Visa ending in 3194 was charged $68.92, which is the correct total difference.
- The problem is that the order record shows the luggage line with the skateboard's details ("bamboo, 34 inch, custom" at $217.06) instead of the red luggage set's. This looks like a display error in the record, since the item ID and the charge are both correct. Still, I can't fix the record myself, and I can't make any more item changes on this order.

If you'd like, I can transfer you to a human agent to check and correct the luggage line on order #W3295833. Do you want me to do that? Or is there anything else I can help with?
